title: Context is a budget, not a brain

questions.question: What is context?
options: Information deliberately supplied for a model call
questions.explanation: Context is the material available in this turn. The harness decides what arrives on later calls.

questions.question: What is the best first response to an uncertain model answer?
options: Ask the model to be more confident
questions.explanation: Find the evidence or constraint that is missing. More irrelevant material usually creates more ambiguity.
